parameters.content:
## Setup after import
1. Open **Choose Chat Model**, select your model and credentials.
2. Import this updated workflow into n8n and publish it before using its Production URL.
3. PDF uploads from Study Studio are split into files, extracted with **Extract PDF Text**, and combined with any pasted notes before reaching the model. TXT, Markdown, and CSV files are read in the browser and sent as notes.
4. Scanned PDFs need an OCR step; this workflow only extracts embedded PDF text.
5. For a notes-only test, select **Listen for Test Event** on the Webhook node, then submit notes from Study Studio.
6. Set **Allowed Origins (CORS)** to the origin serving your HTML. Restrict it for a deployed page.

The Webhook receives files under the multipart `files` field. The preparation Code node finds uploaded PDF binaries even when multiple files are present. It stops with a clear error if no usable source text reaches the model.

The study pack includes a multiple-choice quiz: up to five questions with four options each and a zero-based correct-answer index.
The HTML form lets learners request 1–50 quiz questions (default 5); the workflow uses that count as an upper target and will not invent questions to fill it.
